headline: Strong deal momentum and guidance upgrade making it a midcap outlier

highlights: Revenue grew 3.3% q/q and 9.7% y/y in CC, with Direct business growing 3.5% q/q and 11.3% y/y CC.
Growth is being supported by a favourable shift in deal composition, with shorter-cycle engagements improving revenue conversion.
However, monetisation remains at an early stage, with management indicating that FY27 will be a foundational year for Tria.

Operating margin declined 40 q/q at 15.9%; higher onsite deployment requirements, acquisition-related amortisation and continued investments in AI capabilities and client coverage are weighing on near-term profitability.
valuation: Mphasis Tria is emerging as a differentiator in large deal evaluations, enabling the company to move beyond traditional IT budgets into business process transformation and outcome-linked engagements.
Management is targeting ~80% OCF/PAT conversion for FY27, making improvement in working capital and collections a key monitorable.
Outlook & Valuation: At CMP, Mphasis trades at 18.8x/16.9x FY28/29e P/E.
watch: Cash conversion also remains a monitorable, with delayed collections and elevated receivable days affecting quarterly cash generation.
Cash conversion remains a concern for us: OCF/PAT at ~(10%) and +57% after normalising for delayed collections in Oct’26.
